quote: The possibility of a graph with these parameters was already suggested in 1969 by Norman L. Biggs
note: Despite being called 'Conway's 99-graph problem', it was actually first posed by Norman L. Biggs in 1969. John Conway became more prominently associated with it later, particularly after offering a $1,000 prize for solving it in 2014.
